bonus_hunt.tagline: ABQ BioPark bonus · primates + giraffe + cheetah

challenges.text: Chimps: spot hands used like tools.
Reticulated giraffe: count the spots you can see on one neck.
Cheetah: statue score 1–10 after 20 quiet seconds.
